# Screenshot Planning — Obsidian IDE Bridge

## Screenshots

### 1. Vault Settings Configuration
- **Title:** "Easy Vault Connection"
- **What to capture:** The plugin settings page under Settings → Tools → Obsidian IDE Bridge, showing the vault path configuration, auto-index toggle, and file extension filters.

### 2. Backlinks Tool Window
- **Title:** "Backlinks Explorer"
- **What to capture:** The Backlinks tool window showing a list of notes that reference the currently open file, with note titles and wiki-link previews.

### 3. Wiki-Link Completion
- **Title:** "Smart Wiki-Link Completion"
- **What to capture:** The editor showing auto-completion suggestions while typing a `[[` wiki-link, with vault note names appearing in the completion popup.

### 4. Wiki-Link Navigation
- **Title:** "Click-to-Navigate Links"
- **What to capture:** The editor gutter showing wiki-link line markers (navigation icons) next to lines containing `[[wiki-links]]`, with the navigation popup visible.

### 5. Vault Search
- **Title:** "Full-Text Vault Search"
- **What to capture:** The vault search dialog showing search results across all vault notes, with matched content highlighted and file paths visible.

### 6. Tag Tree Tool Window
- **Title:** "Hierarchical Tag Browser (Pro)"
- **What to capture:** The Tag Tree tool window showing a hierarchical tree of tags extracted from vault notes, with note counts next to each tag.

### 7. Status Bar Widget
- **Title:** "Vault Status at a Glance"
- **What to capture:** The IDE status bar showing the Obsidian vault widget with the connected vault name and indexed note count.

### 8. Daily Note Creation
- **Title:** "Quick Daily Notes (Pro)"
- **What to capture:** The daily note action dialog or the newly created daily note in the editor, showing the date-based filename and template content.

---

## Video Demo Outline (45 seconds)

| Time | Scene | Description |
|------|-------|-------------|
| 0-5s | Intro | Show plugin name and tagline |
| 5-15s | Connect vault | Open settings, configure vault path, show indexing progress |
| 15-25s | Navigate | Type a wiki-link with completion, click gutter icon to navigate |
| 25-35s | Explore | Show backlinks panel, search vault, browse tag tree |
| 35-40s | Daily note | Create a daily note with one click |
| 40-45s | CTA | Show "Install from JetBrains Marketplace" with plugin URL |
